standard_prerequisites: presentations of complete algebras and free resolutions of the quotient
the henselization of a Noetherian pair and its G-ring stability under polynomial rings
Artin approximation for the henselization to completion map of a G-ring pair
the close-enough lemma giving a congruence threshold under which quotient completions are isomorphic
the easy algebraization lemma identifying a completion of a quotient of the henselization with a completed finite type A-algebra
core_obligations: Prove that a rig-smooth object B of the chapter's category over a Noetherian G-ring A with ideal I is isomorphic as an A-algebra to the completion C^wedge of a finite type A-algebra C
proof_roadmap: Fix a presentation B = P/J with P = A[x_1,...,x_r]^wedge, generators g_1,...,g_m of J and the t relations k_i assembled into the matrix K, so the natural resolution of B is displayed
Since A is a G-ring so is the polynomial ring, and approximation holds for the henselization to completion map of the pair, with respect to the I-adic ideal
Choose n as in the close-enough lemma and approximate: relations k'_ij and generators g'_j over the henselization satisfying the same equations, with g_i - g'_i and K - K' in I^n

The close-enough threshold makes the quotient completions isomorphic: B is isomorphic to P/(g') which is the completion of the finite type A-algebra A[x]^h/(g'), concluding by the easy algebraization lemma
difficulty_reason: H2: an approximation argument assembling a presentation, the G-ring approximation property and the congruence-isomorphism lemma; each step is written out with its quoted input.
